Definition
In this lesson, you will determine if a diode limiter and clamper circuit is faulted and if so, what the fault is.
INTRODUCTIONM
The oscilloscope is used to determine if the circuit is operating correctly by comparing the input and output waveforms.
The waveform measurement will indicate several probable faults such as an open series component or a shorted parallel component.
Resistance measurements determine the faulty component.
Let's begin the lesson on LIMITER AND CLAMPER TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE......
